target_customer: Customer support teams and outsourcing firms that run Zendesk, plus e-commerce merchants and startups
problem: Support agents spend time drafting replies, translating tickets, searching knowledge bases and summarizing threads by hand.
business_model: B2B SaaS app sold through the Zendesk Marketplace with a two week free trial
product_category: AI assistant for customer support agents (Zendesk app)

founders.name: Terry Djony
education: Unnamed top tech university in Indonesia, left in 2021 to work on the startup full time
previous_startups: Chatbot development agency started during his third year of college
founders.background_notes: YC profile says he taught himself software engineering at 13. The launch post mentions co-founders without naming them.

competitors.name: Zendesk Answer Bot and macro suggestions
competitors.what: Zendesk's own automated answers and suggested macros inside its support product
competitors.traction_then: Native to the Zendesk platform in 2021

technical_complexity.rationale: In 2021 the product wrapped language models for drafting, translation and summarizing inside a Zendesk app, which needed integration work and model tuning but not research.

defensibility.rationale: A Zendesk Marketplace app with features that the platform owner could add itself, and no data or network lock in is described.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Zendesk later shipped its own generative AI agent assist features, per its 2023 and later announcements; no acquisition of FirstSupport was found.

market_need_then: Support teams were adopting Zendesk at scale and Zendesk had already bought AI automation talent in 2021, which signals demand for agent productivity tools. No spend figures were found.

branding.domain_note: Uses firstsupport.ai, an .ai domain; acquisition history unknown.

identity.logo: Logo shown on directory pages; no description found
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain feature led copy: give support agents AI superpowers

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand, community or merch was found; only directory listings.

outcome_analysis: FirstSupport remains active with a team of four based in Bandung and no public funding or exit. It has distributed through the Zendesk Marketplace, which is cheap distribution but leaves it exposed because Zendesk later built comparable AI assist features itself. Without disclosed revenue or rounds the trajectory is unclear.
notes: Company website returned HTTP 503 on fetch. No funding source found in a funding search and a cross-check search. Kore.ai AgentAssist for Zendesk was seen but its date was not confirmed, so it is not listed.
